title: Nutty Cheesy Venezuelan Turnips Quesadilla
description: A nostalgic Venezuelan dish featuring turnips, flambe, and plant-based friendly cheesy goodness.

ingredients.name: Vegan cheese shreds
ingredients.notes: Such as Daiya or Follow Your Heart

ingredients.name: Flour tortillas
ingredients.notes: Look for vegan or gluten-free options

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the turnips and cook until they are tender and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the vegan cheese shreds and stir until melted and smooth.
Transfer the turnip and cheese mixture to a bowl and stir in the chopped cilantro, scallions, lime juice, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in the same skillet over medium heat.
Place a tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle a quarter of the turnip and cheese mixture onto half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the tortilla is crispy and the filling is heated through.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the other side is also crispy and the filling is heated through.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot.
Sprinkle with nutritional yeast and serve immediately.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and scallions, if desired.
